title: tests/integration files that never call tenant_context.set()/.clear() rely on ambient thread-local state left by whichever test ran immediately before them in main_test.zig's fixed declaration order
resolution: Audited all 88 tests/integration/*.zig files with a local makePool() helper. 56 never called tenant_context.set()/.clear() anywhere in the file (CONFIRMED BUG); 3 more called it only after fixture-setup pool.acquire() calls had already run (PARTIAL). Of the 56, 3 were excluded after reachability verification: iss0076_secrets_table_test.zig is safe as written (its one raw Pool.init() runs immediately after helpers.TestHarness.init(), which already sets tenant_context correctly), and oidc31_end_to_end_auth_suite_test.zig / oidc08_claim_mapping_config_test.zig are unreachable dead code never wired into any build.zig target or main_test.zig import (same defect class as GitHub #439, which already tracks both files plus 5 more OIDC files this audit incidentally confirmed unreachable). Applied the existing house convention (bpm.api_tenant_context.set(DEFAULT_TENANT_ID) as the first statement in makePool(), before Pool.init()) to the remaining 49 files (46 confirmed + 3 partial). See src/design/fix-ISS-0145.md for full method and file lists.
verification: zig build test-integration-svc and zig build test-integration-env each run 3 consecutive times post-fix: identical 476/543 passed (7 skipped, 59 failed, 1 crashed) every run on both targets, byte-identical failing-test-name sets across all 6 runs (diff exit 0 in every pairwise comparison). Pre-fix baseline was ~291/543 failing per GitHub #457's own report. C42P01 'relation does not exist' errors against tenant_default-scoped tables (the specific symptom) are eliminated; the umbrella zig build test-integration run in the same session showed only 3 comparable C42P01 occurrences, all against per-test dynamically-provisioned tenant schemas (a different, expected mechanism), matching the acceptance criteria's 'comparable to the umbrella's own rate' bar. The 59 remaining stable failures on -svc/-env are a separate, pre-existing, already-tracked class (assertion mismatches, allocation leaks, cascade-delete logic) unrelated to tenant_context ordering -- out of scope for this issue.
scope: tests/integration/*.zig files that are @import-ed into tests/integration/main_test.zig and compiled into multiple separate binaries (run_integration_tests, svc_integration_tests, env_integration_tests). Discovered while verifying the ISS-0144 / GitHub #454 fix.
symptom: Running `zig build test-integration-svc` (or `-env`) standalone -- which compiles the identical tests/integration/main_test.zig source into its own separate binary, per build.zig -- reproducibly fails ~291 of 543 tests with `POSTGRES ERROR: C42P01 relation "<table>" does not exist` for core tenant_default business tables (process_definitions, users, api_tokens, instance_projections, events, etc.), even though the SAME table set is confirmed present (66 tables) both immediately before and immediately after the run. The identical main_test.zig source run via the actual `zig build test-integration` umbrella target does not show this severity (2 occurrences of the same signature vs. ~330+ when run standalone via -svc). db_integration_test.zig's TC-DB-03-01 (5th test in file order) is a confirmed, reproduced instance: its own makePool() helper (tests/integration/db_integration_test.zig lines 44-49) calls bare Pool.init() with no tenant_context.set()/.clear() call of its own -- unlike every other test-integration file's makePool(), which explicitly calls bpm.api_tenant_context.set("00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000") before Pool.init() so that Pool.acquire()'s applyRequestStorageRouting() resolves the correct schema. TC-DB-01-01 and TC-DB-01-02 (which run before it, same file) pass; TC-DB-02-03/TC-DB-02-04 (pool-sizing tests, also no tenant_context calls) run between them and TC-DB-03-01.
root_cause_analysis: tenant_context (src/api/tenant_context.zig) is process-wide threadlocal state, not per-test. Pool.acquire()'s applyRequestStorageRouting() (src/db/pool.zig) branches on tenant_context.get()/getStorageMode() to decide whether a connection's search_path routes to `public` (empty/no tenant) or `<tenant_schema>,public` (resolved tenant, SCHEMA mode). A test file whose own makePool()/setup code never explicitly calls tenant_context.set(...) or .clear() is implicitly depending on whatever the IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING test (in main_test.zig's fixed @import/declaration order, since Zig's std.testing runner executes test blocks in that order within one binary) happened to leave tenant_context set to when ITS test function returned. This is not a bug in Pool/tenant_context themselves (their contract is stateless-modulo-explicit-set, which is reasonable) -- it is an implicit ordering dependency in every test file that never calls .set()/.clear() itself, silently relying on a "lucky" leftover value from an unrelated file. Not yet isolated to a single specific offending predecessor test/file for the standalone -svc/-env failure amplification; requires either (a) auditing every test-integration file @import-ed into main_test.zig for a missing tenant_context.set() call in its own setup path (the same audit pattern ISS-0144's fix applied file-by-file for the ensureSchemaReady() gap), or (b) instrumenting tenant_context.set()/.clear() call sites to log (file, test name, value) and diffing between a -svc run and the umbrella run to find exactly which predecessor's leftover value differs between the two invocation modes and why.
acceptance_criteria: Identify every tests/integration/*.zig file (reachable from main_test.zig) whose own setup path never calls bpm.api_tenant_context.set() or .clear() before its first Pool.acquire() -- db_integration_test.zig is a confirmed instance; there may be others.

For each identified file, add an explicit tenant_context.set(DEFAULT_TENANT_ID) (or .clear(), matching the test's intent) in its own makePool()/setup helper so the test's correctness does not depend on execution order or a sibling file's leftover state.

zig build test-integration-svc and zig build test-integration-env each produce a stable, low failure count (comparable to the umbrella zig build test-integration's own failure rate for the same underlying main_test.zig content) across at least 3 consecutive runs on an otherwise-unchanged tree.

Consider (design decision, not mandatory for close) making Pool.acquire() or TestHarness.init() fail loudly/assert in test builds when tenant_context has never been explicitly set in the current thread, rather than silently routing to whatever the ambient default happens to be -- this would convert future instances of this class of bug into an immediate, obvious failure at the offending call site instead of a confusing downstream 'table does not exist'.
evidence_file: N/A -- see symptom/root_cause_analysis fields; raw run logs (svc_run1.log through svc_run5.log, full_run1.log through full_run4.log) were captured to the WF03-gh454-20260806 session's scratchpad during investigation (not committed; regenerate via `zig build test-integration-svc --summary all` on a cleaned bpm_test database).
